## Checklist

- [ ] Repo: public, not archived, has a license, commit within 12 months
- [ ] Asset source: states how content may be used, license link included
- [ ] I added one entry to `data/entries.json` or `data/resources.json` and ran `python scripts/build_readme.py`
- [ ] Description is plain words and mentions any limits (credit, non-commercial, paid keys)
- [ ] No affiliate or tracking links
- [ ] Added a line to CHANGELOG.md
